card.name: Ending of fixed phrases and coadministered
card.fires_on: The last piece of a set phrase or a word that completes a common expression, such as the ending of "coadminister(ed)", "one size fits all", "standard configuration", or "high end". It is strongest on "ed" in coadministered.
